decision.reason: evidence sufficient (proxy gate verdict; the open aspects need proposals): The release note [ev-be13d23a0cf1] is only a commit title, but the linked PR [ev-b161f0981be8] says exactly what changed. In the application webhook handler, the `sourceRevisionHasChanged` method used to do a simple equality check. It now checks whether the revision sent by the webhook matches the application's target revision when that target revision is a semver constraint. The PR also notes that semver constraints for Git revisions exist only from 2.12. The changed files [ev-f67fb6fc7789][ev-b370efb62b5b] confirm the fix is limited to util/webhook/webhook.go, and the cherry-pick [ev-00578b61cfa7] is the same fix. This is enough to write the assertion. Subject: the webhook revision-change check. Change: equality check becomes a semver-constraint match. Exposure: apps that use Git webhooks and set the target revision to a semver constraint. Consequence (inferred, not stated by the PR): a webhook push of a matching tag now triggers the app refresh that the equality check would have skipped.
